title: Next-Manip: On-Demand Agent-Policy Collaboration for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32533v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: General-purpose robotic manipulation requires task reasoning, failure recovery, and precise control, yet limited manipulation data make these abilities difficult to obtain from a single policy. Recent multimodal agents show promise in task reasoning and recovery but lack reliable fine-grained control and incur high inference cost, whereas learned policies provide efficient fine-grained execution but struggle beyond their learned skills. Although their complementary strengths suggest combining the two, doing so requires repeatedly deciding which executor should act as task demands change. Instead of relying on the agent for each decision, we present Next-Manip, an on-demand agent--policy collaboration framework that decouples executor allocation from costly agent inference. We propose an Agent Invocation Controller (AIC) that allocates control between the policy and the agent through a lightweight classifier of current execution demands

translated_title: Next-Manip：面向机器人操作的按需智能体-策略协作
translated_abstract: 通用机器人操作需要任务推理、失败恢复和精确控制，然而有限的操作数据使得这些能力难以从单一策略中获得。近期的多模态智能体在任务推理和失败恢复方面展现出潜力，但缺乏可靠的细粒度控制且推理成本高昂；而学习到的策略能够高效地进行细粒度执行，但在其已学技能之外则表现不佳。尽管两者优势互补、看似适合结合，但这需要随着任务需求的变化反复决定应由哪个执行器行动。不同于在每次决策时都依赖智能体，我们提出了 Next-Manip，这是一个按需的智能体-策略协作框架，将执行器的分配与代价高昂的智能体推理解耦。我们提出了智能体调用控制器，它通过一个轻量级的当前执行需求分类器，在策略与智能体之间分配控制权。
tldr: Next-Manip 提出了一个按需的智能体-策略协作框架，通过轻量级的智能体调用控制器根据当前执行需求在策略与智能体之间动态分配控制权，将执行器分配与高成本的智能体推理解耦，从而兼顾任务推理、失败恢复与高效精确的细粒度控制。
en_tdlr: Next-Manip is an on-demand agent-policy collaboration framework that decouples executor allocation from costly agent inference, using a lightweight Agent Invocation Controller (AIC) to dynamically allocate control between the policy and the agent based on current execution demands.
